body:
We are helping a language learner distinguish meanings that are useful to distinguish.

The supplied *lemma* is already resolved and fixed. Do not revise it.
Consider only the use marked by <TARGET>...</TARGET> in *markedContext*.

Compare the marked use with the supplied existingEmojiDescriptions for this
Lemma. When an existing description represents the same learner-facing concept,
copy that description exactly. Otherwise create a description that is absent
from the supplied list.

An emojiDescription contains only one to four Unicode RGI emoji graphemes.
Never include the lemma, a gloss, or explanatory text.

The lemma remains visible to the learner. The emoji only needs to distinguish
that lemma's learner-facing Readings; it does not need to identify the lemma by
itself.

Describe only meaning that stays stable across attestations. Omit scenery,
participants, tense, and other incidental details from the marked context.
Prefer one conventional emoji by default. Use multiple emoji only when they
preserve stable, useful lexical structure that one emoji cannot.

Transparent prefixes, particles, or compound members may receive consistent
emoji components when they add useful stable structure. Never illustrate
opaque or fossilized components mechanically.

We follow a "do not split semantic pennies" policy:

1. Different homonyms need different emoji descriptions.
2. Related or polysemous uses should reuse one description unless doing so would
   materially mislead a beginner.
3. Prefer one broad, recognizable learner-facing concept over narrow
   dictionary-style distinctions.

Return exactly { "emojiDescription": string }. The application determines the
Reuse or New result from exact candidate membership; no decision field is part
of this response.

reading-de-adj-sauer-acidic-reuse.explanation: Same sour taste across bearer and inflection. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Nach der Absage war Lea <TARGET>sauer</TARGET> auf ihren Chef.
Wegen der Verspätung ist er noch immer <TARGET>sauer</TARGET>.

reading-de-adj-leicht-easy.explanation: Easy, not low in weight. New.

reading-de-adj-leicht-easy-reuse.explanation: Easy to understand. Same broad difficulty reading. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Das Messer ist <TARGET>scharf</TARGET> genug, um das Brot zu schneiden.
Nach fünf Bier war er völlig <TARGET>blau</TARGET>.

reading-de-adj-menschlich-human.explanation: Relating to humans. First reading. New.

input.markedContext: Ihr Umgang mit den Patienten war stets <TARGET>menschlich</TARGET>.

reading-de-adj-menschlich-humane.explanation: Humane and compassionate, not merely human. New.

reading-de-adp-ueber-connector.explanation: verfügen über fixed. über only links. New.

reading-de-adp-ueber-above.explanation: Above, not a generic connector. New.

input.markedContext: Mara schneidet das Brot <TARGET>mit</TARGET> einem Messer.

reading-de-adp-mit-connector.explanation: rechnen mit fixed. mit only links.

reading-de-adp-nach-sensory-characterist.explanation: A perceived characteristic resembles the complement; this remains broader than the particular smell and is not directional. New.

input.markedContext: Sie ruft mich <TARGET>vor</TARGET> dem Essen an.
Die Besucher saßen auf einer langen <TARGET>Bank</TARGET>.
Wir sitzen auf einer <TARGET>Bank</TARGET> im Park.

reading-de-bank-park-bench.explanation: Same seating object. The park is only scenery. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Sie hebt Geld bei der <TARGET>Bank</TARGET> ab.

reading-de-noun-bank-financial-reuse.explanation: Same financial institution in another context. Reuse.

reading-de-noun-maus-computer-reuse.explanation: Same computer device with a contextual detail. Reuse.

reading-de-noun-absatz-sales-new.explanation: Product sales, not a shoe heel. New.

input.markedContext: Der erste <TARGET>Absatz</TARGET> führt das Thema ein.

reading-de-noun-absatz-paragraph-new.explanation: Text paragraph, neither a shoe heel nor sales. New.

reading-de-tea.explanation: The supplied cup already represents the stable tea concept. Reuse.

reading-de-kitchen-room.explanation: The kitchen room, independent of the coffee-drinking scene. New.

input.markedContext: Mit diesem <TARGET>Zug</TARGET> setzt sie den König schachmatt.

reading-de-leitung-management.explanation: Management, not a conducting line. New.

reading-de-construction-fusion-am-tempor.explanation: The fused form marks a calendar-time relation, not a place. New.

input.markedContext: Wir reisen <TARGET>entweder</TARGET> am Freitag <TARGET>oder</TARGET> am Samstag.

reading-de-lexeme-cconj-entweder-oder.explanation: The multi-member Lexeme/CCONJ presents alternatives. Reuse.

reading-de-lexeme-det-der-neighbor-house.explanation: Definite article. The houses are the referent, not the determiner's meaning.

input.markedContext: Das Haus, <TARGET>das</TARGET> dort steht, ist alt.

reading-de-lexeme-pron-das-relative-neig.explanation: Relative pronoun. The house is its antecedent, not the pronoun's meaning.

reading-de-lexeme-det-der-neighbor-car-i.explanation: Definite article. The car is the referent, not the determiner's meaning.

reading-de-lexeme-pron-die-relative-neig.explanation: Relative pronoun. The cat and feminine agreement belong to its antecedent, not the pronoun's meaning.

input.markedContext: Er arbeitet <TARGET>sonst</TARGET> im Homeoffice, heute aber im Büro.

reading-de-lexeme-adv-sonst-usual.explanation: Usual circumstances, not an otherwise-warning reading. New.

reading-de-lexeme-aux-werden-passive.explanation: Passive auxiliary use, not future prediction. New.

reading-de-lexeme-det-dieser-demonstrati.explanation: Demonstrative selection of a particular referent. Reuse.

reading-de-lexeme-intj-hurra-celebration.explanation: A stable exclamation of celebration. New.

input.markedContext: <TARGET>Während</TARGET> Lea gern früh beginnt, arbeitet Amir lieber abends.

reading-de-lexeme-sconj-waehrend-adversa.explanation: Adversative contrast, not temporal duration. New.

reading-de-lexeme-propn-berlin-city-reus.explanation: The city Berlin, independent of this residence scene. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Er antwortete im Chat nur mit <TARGET>lol</TARGET>.

reading-de-lexeme-x-lol-laughter-reuse.explanation: The chat expression marks laughter. Reuse.

reading-de-morpheme-suffix-chen-neighbor.explanation: Diminutive suffix. House belongs to the base; smallness is the suffix's stable contribution.

reading-de-phraseme-collocation-entschei.explanation: The collocation denotes reaching a decision; all three lexical members form one stable concept. New.
The same decision-making collocation in another attestation. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Obwohl er anderer Meinung war, <TARGET>heulte</TARGET> er <TARGET>mit</TARGET> <TARGET>den</TARGET> <TARGET>Wölfen</TARGET>.

reading-de-idiom-mit-den-woelfen-heulen.explanation: Follow the group despite disagreement. Whole idiom. New.

input.markedContext: Als sie von seiner Krankheit hörte, sagte sie: „<TARGET>Das</TARGET> <TARGET>tut</TARGET> <TARGET>mir</TARGET> <TARGET>leid</TARGET>.“

reading-de-phraseme-discourse-formula-da.explanation: A conventional expression of sympathy, not literal regret about an action. Reuse.

reading-de-phraseme-aphorism-zeit-ist-ge.explanation: The aphorism equates time with money. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Im Projekt durfte nun jeder mitentscheiden – <TARGET>viele</TARGET> <TARGET>Köche</TARGET> <TARGET>verderben</TARGET> <TARGET>den</TARGET> <TARGET>Brei</TARGET>.

reading-de-phraseme-proverb-viele-koeche.explanation: The proverb warns that too many participants spoil the result. Reuse.

input.markedContext: Bei der dritten Zwischenfrage <TARGET>verlor</TARGET> die Rednerin <TARGET>den</TARGET> <TARGET>Faden</TARGET>.

reading-de-phraseme-idiom-den-faden-verl.explanation: Losing one's train of thought, not losing literal thread. Reuse.

reading-de-lexeme-verb-laufen-operate-ne.explanation: A machine operating is not physical running. Create a stable operation reading.

reading-de-lexeme-verb-laufen-operate-re.explanation: A motor operating is the same broad machine-operation reading. Reuse.

reading-de-aufstehen-uprising.explanation: Revolt. Auf adds upward structure. New.

reading-de-aufstehen-morning-six.explanation: Get out of bed. Auf adds upward structure. New.
